docs.text:
Mary Lennox, sent from India to a Yorkshire manor, finds a locked garden.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Frances Hodgson Burnett (1849–1924), The Secret Garden, 1911. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution.
